title: Operator-norm unit bound for ± simple n-vectors of orthonormal frames
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and let τ = (τ_1, …, τ_n) : Fin n → ℝ^P be an orthonormal family. Let w ∈ Λ_n(ℝ^P) (NVector (Eucl P) n, a continuous linear functional on n-covectors) satisfy w = simpleNVector τ or w = −simpleNVector τ. Then |w(α)| ≤ ‖α‖ for every n-covector α (Covector (Eucl P) n: a continuous alternating n-linear map ℝ^P → ℝ, with its operator norm ‖α‖).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (τ : Fin n → Eucl P) (w : NVector (Eucl P) n), Orthonormal ℝ τ → (w = simpleNVector τ ∨ w = -simpleNVector τ) → ∀ α : Covector (Eucl P) n, |w α| ≤ ‖α‖
